name: How To Make Peace
overview: Scripture reveals that making peace begins with turning away from evil and actively pursuing good, as Psalms 34:14 instructs. True peace is found in Christ, the Prince of Peace (Isaiah 9:6), who offers a peace unlike the world’s, calming troubled hearts (John 14:27) and assuring believers victory over tribulation (John 16:33). Those who seek and promote peace are blessed and recognized as God's children (Matthew 5:9), confident that God works all things together for good for those who love Him (Romans 8:28).
